description: Gated notify_crew message templates. Variables use {{snake_case}} placeholders.

templates.label: Window opens — crew dispatch
templates.subject: {{location}} — coating window
templates.body: {{trade_short}} on {{location}}: window opens {{opens}}, closes {{closes}}. Crew call {{call_time}}. Scheduled {{scheduled_start}}. Reply ACK.

templates.label: Shift confirmed — pour moved
templates.subject: {{activity_id}} moved to {{new_start}}
templates.body: {{trade_short}} {{activity_id}} on {{location}} moved from {{previous_start}} to {{new_start}}. {{reason}} Hold points unchanged.

templates.label: Hold — continuity window missing
templates.subject: HOLD {{location}} — {{trade_short}}
templates.body: {{trade_short}} on {{location}} ON HOLD. No compliant {{continuity_hours}} h run before {{hold_until}}. {{mitigation}} Do not mobilise until cleared.

templates.label: Split approved — two-pass coating
templates.subject: {{activity_id}} split around pour
templates.body: {{trade_short}} {{activity_id}} runs {{pass1_hours}} h at {{pass1_start}}, then {{pass2_hours}} h at {{pass2_start}}. Gate rule {{rule_id}}. Float spent {{float_days}} d.

templates.label: Escalation — superintendent review
templates.subject: Escalation — {{activity_id}}
templates.body: Policy gate denied {{rule_id}} on {{activity_id}}. {{rationale}} Open WORKFACE Trace for the full tradeoff.

sample_vars.rationale: Cheapest fix burns 4 d float on near-critical deck weld.

templates.label: WBGT — crew rest ratio
templates.subject: Heat stress — {{location}}
templates.body: WBGT {{wbgt_c}} °C on {{location}} at {{peak_time}}. Work/rest {{work_rest_ratio}}. Productive hours haircut {{haircut_pct}}%. Plan water + shade.
